answer: Raise the cost of farms with a delayed-unlock work bond. A new identity must lock a jade of spendable stake that stays frozen until many independently attested rounds have passed. That deposit sits like a crystal reserve at the inlet of membership: it cannot be transferred, reused, or borrowed across accounts. Graders reject near-duplicate answers and slash any cluster that shares a template. A sybil operator then has to fund a unique bond for every head and still loses it if the copies are caught, so mass onboarding stops paying.
